title.en: Tale 34 — The Neighbour Who Never Returns

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: جار جحا كان يستعير ولا يرجع.
sentences.en: Juha's neighbour would borrow and not return.
He borrowed the saw, the rope, and the ladder.
One day he came and said: I want your donkey.
Juha said: the donkey is travelling.

sentences.ar: قال جحا: راح يجيب أغراضي من عندك.
sentences.en: Juha said: it went to bring my things back from your house.
